name: TLS server -> chatgpt.com
description: All TLS configs get server / host / sni set to chatgpt.com.
details: When enabled, every client config with security=tls has three fields rewritten:
- server (the address the client connects to) → chatgpt.com
Reality configs and non-TLS configs are untouched.
No rebuild is needed — toggle the switch and the next config generation picks it up immediately.
author: spiderpanel
